name: Concierge Minimum Viable Product
phase: Low-Fidelity Prototyping and Smoke Testing Tactics
hypothesis: We believe that [client segment] will pay for [automated service outcome]. We will verify this by manually delivering the service end-to-end for 5 businesses for three consecutive weeks, and consider it validated if ≥ 4 clients complete the trial and agree to retain the service on a paid monthly basis.
schematic: Delivery at step 2 of the 3-step strip

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Define the manual workflow, tools and client channel, and say the onboarding is white-glove.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Deliver every unit by hand and count the human hours each one costs.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Log satisfaction, hours per delivery, edge cases and retention.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Define the manual operating workflow, tools, and direct customer communication channels (e.g., Slack, email, shared spreadsheets). Be explicit with the customer that this initial phase involves hands-on white-glove onboarding.

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Fulfill the service entirely by hand behind the scenes. Track all human labor hours required to deliver the promised value proposition.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Document customer satisfaction, time spent per unit of delivery, operational edge cases, and client retention rates.

warning.label: White-Glove Bias
warning.text: Clients stay for the attentive human, then churn when the software replaces it.

warningFull: Customers often stick with the service primarily because they enjoy the direct, highly attentive human consulting, then churn the moment the experience is replaced with self-serve software.
